rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Fresh walk of every pronoun/demonstrative in every chunk against the current body (source_sha f884138e, changed from the last-judged ea08e019 only in the chunk-8 Wollsen sentence, line 56). Chunks 0-7: every 'it'/'its'/'that whole shape'/'the first' resolves inside its own chunk to a noun named in the same or immediately preceding clause (the agent, a whole task shape, the second task vs the first, one task, a loop, its surroundings, the limit). Line 39 'held by calibration, the checking of the checks' is the term's first appearance but is glossed in the same clause by its own appositive, so it does not depend on Part 2 -- a deliberate quiet-clue per the maintainer note ('quiet clues toward the reveal'), not an unresolved forward reference. Chunk 8's new wording (line 56) 'he kept output volume and delivered value on separate axes' resolves 'axes' inside the SAME chunk: the diagram immediately above (line 49, expanded SVG line 86) carries the visible label 'TWO AXES · FOUR STATES' and the axis captions 'REACH ... →' / 'CALIBRATION ... ↑', so the metaphor is grounded in-chunk rather than assumed. 'its pull-request count' resolves to 'his four-engineer team' two clauses earlier. Chunk 9 line 62 'Read the doors again' and 'an unfamiliar codebase' are same-file callbacks to the 'The door is trust...' seams (chunks 2-6) and chunk 3's codebase line -- both allowed by the NOT-violations clause (term introduced earlier in the same file, reused). No never-named, vague-with-full-history, or re-chunk-stranded referent found anywhere in the file.

The file's only two links are named by title inline, not positioned: line 9 '[The AI-Native Engineering Playbook: Crawl, Walk, Run, Fly]' and line 56 '[This is getting ridiculous: I shipped 490 pull requests in June]' (unchanged by the diff, which only edited prose after the second link). No 'the opening lecture said' / 'earlier in this course' style positional phrasing anywhere in body; no navigational pointer to another in-repo document at all, so the navigational-pointer carve-out isn't in play either way.

Every chunk carries a self-carrying claim: chunk 0 states the discipline in one sentence; each level chunk (2-7) states the level's work plus a three-beat Moves-you-up seam; chunk 8 carries the diagram, four defining bullets, and the Wollsen data point; chunk 9 states the model's unity. None is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet. Unaffected by the diff (which only reworded prose inside chunk 8, not its structure).

Checked each header against its own chunk body fresh: 'Assistance' -> 'AI helps with work already on your desk' (13); 'Interactive work' -> 'One conversation, one task' (19); 'Delegating bounded outcomes' -> 'You hand over an outcome, not a step' (25); 'Directing parallel sessions' -> 'You direct several sessions rather than one conversation' (31); 'Encoding checked loops' -> 'Recurring work becomes a loop with its own checks' (37); 'Improving the system' -> 'You improve the context, memory, skills, and verification' (43); 'Part 2: The leverage model' -> diagram + Reach/Calibration bullets (49-54), unaffected by the line-56 reword; 'One model, not two' -> 'The progression and the leverage model describe the same thing' (62). No header contradicted by its own content.

Re-checked all six sub-items against the current wording, per chunk, over the whole file (not just the diff line). No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction anywhere. Closest anaphora candidate is line 33 'the same handoffs, the same checks, the same merge discipline' -- a single-sentence triple, not the rule's cited cross-sentence tic, and its third leg ('merge discipline') is distinct new content from the first two, clearing the escape clause either way. No self-grading superlatives: the Wollsen sentence is a stated finding about the team's own ratio, not praise of the curriculum. Numeric claims (six levels; 30-40 sessions; 10-15 managed) each stand with their label, no self-retraction pattern -- notably the diff REMOVED the prior 'three to four times... far below the multiple' self-estimate figure and replaced it with a number-free qualitative claim, so this axis is cleaner post-edit than pre-edit. No abstraction-noun stacks: 'calibration states' (62) and 'on separate axes' (56, new) are both directly grounded in the page's own defined vocabulary/diagram, not vague padding standing in for a concrete thing. No verb triplets with an empty leg anywhere in body.

The diff did not touch these bullets (it reworded the prose sentence at line 56, after the bullet list). Checked each of the four bullets against all three classes fresh. (a) doctrine restatement: bullets 1-2 ('**Reach** is...', '**Calibration** is...', 51-52) are the FIRST formal naming of terms only used qualitatively in Part 1, so they are payoff not re-announcement -- the maintainer block confirms this deferral is deliberate ('the reveal is the smart reader's to make first'). Bullet 3 (53) adds the split's two named outcome states; bullet 4 (54) adds the frontier concept plus a distinct prescriptive warning. Each clears the 'what does this add' test. (b) self-referential design commentary: none of the four bullets discuss the curriculum's own pedagogy -- all are substantive claims about the delegation model. (c) aphorism kicker: bullet 4's second clause introduces new content (the checking-vs-delegating reframe) rather than restating the chunk header or a stated point line.
